title: Humanities Writing Companion: An Agent Skill for Voice-Preserving Humanities Academic Writing
description: An end-to-end agent skill, in the open Agent Skills (SKILL.md) format, for humanities scholars (history, philosophy, literature, cultural studies, art history, religious studies, classics, intellectual history, science studies, and adjacent fields) whose primary deliverable is a long-form argumentative text. Not a research pipeline, not a polishing tool, but a thinking partner across the whole writing arc. Twelve work modes (A–L) cover the full lifecycle: research-question sharpening, literature mapping, plan-only outlining, conception and drafting, paragraph dialogue, four-layer chapter critique (foundation/structure/paragraph/sentence), devil's advocate with 1–5 calibration and anti-sycophancy thresholds, writing-bottleneck assistance, draft revision with revision-coach, blind reading, AI-use disclosure for humanities journals, and defense/external-review comment integration via a revision-dossier workflow (Mode L). Features deep-voice preservation, reflexive-writing support for human-AI co-authoring research, discipline-specific critique routing on a three-layer architecture (6 L1 main disciplines with subfield inheritance, 9 L3 cross-disciplinary fields, 2 humanities-adjacent fields), ADHD-friendly interaction design, multi-agent parallel review fan-out in agent-capable environments, and a five-script zero-dependency toolchain (AI-trace scanning, pending-marker aggregation, citation-consistency checking, citation format conversion, Crossref citation verification). Bilingual: SKILL.md, README, and references in English and Chinese.
